title: Alastor Nuh Uh Uh
blurb: A singsong refusal with a smile audible in every syllable. Alastor spends most of Hazbin Hotel declining to explain himself, and this cheerful little denial is the compressed version of that: no reason offered, no negotiation available, conversation closed. The fandom seized on it immediately because it fits practically any situation where somebody is being told no by a person clearly enjoying themselves enormously. Works as a Discord soundboard button, works pinned under a comment, works as a reply to any request you were never going to grant.
origin: Alastor's playful refusal from Hazbin Hotel.
